message.content:
Yes, there are a few people visible in the scene, though they are quite small and distant. They can be seen along the parking area on the left side of the image, near the brick building (the Fort Point / Presidio building) that sits at the base of the Golden Gate Bridge.

Specifically, you can make out a small group of people standing or walking along the paved parking strip in front of the brick building. There appear to be at least a few figures—some in dark clothing and at least one in a lighter/white shirt—positioned near the row of parked cars (a silver sedan, a dark car, and a white van are visible). They are too small to make out individual details, but their presence is clear in that parking area.

No other people are visible in the water, on the bridge, or on the hills in the background.
